response.algorithm: Disjoint-set forest (union by size, path halving)
caveats: A shared identifier is a hint, not proof: transitive linking can merge unrelated documents if an identifier is common (an insurer name, a shared phone number). Identifiers shared by 4 or more documents are flagged as broad.
Identifiers are compared exactly as entered (no case, whitespace or Unicode folding), so a differently written identifier does not link.
This groups documents only. It does not establish that they belong to one agreement or what they mean, and nothing is merged or stored.
